title: RoC Skincare aims to rank among France's top 3 anti-aging brands
summary: Two years after its comeback to the French market, dermocosmetics brand RoC Skincare achieved 500% sell-out growth in 2025, and is forecasting a 200% increase in 2026. title: Hou Juncheng: “Proya is moving closer to European suppliers and expertise”
summary: Located in Suresnes, near Paris, France, Proya's newly established 450 m² R&D laboratory already employs seven scientists. title: Fareva in France and Chromavis in Italy join forces in high-end skincare
summary: Fareva and Chromavis are combining their scientific, formulation and creative expertise to develop new skincare concepts, bringing together advanced skin science and Italian creativity. The collaboration within the Fareva group aims to leverage Chromavis' expertise in product design, innovative textures and sensorial experiences with Fareva's formulation and skincare development capabilities in France. title: Male beauty: NIQ identifies growth opportunities beyond men's products
summary: Men are paying increasing attention to their appearance and ageing, but brands specifically targeting male consumers are not necessarily benefiting most from this shift. According to a new report from market research firm NielsenIQ, growth opportunities may lie in a broader approach to beauty and skincare, beyond traditional gender-based positioning. title: Aros Group unveils a hinged paper makeup case with an adjustable mirror
summary: Aros Group, formerly known as Jujin New York, received two distinctions at the 2026 Pentawards for Paper Palette, a paper-based compact built around a proprietary, patent-pending hinge that holds the lid, and its mirror, steady at any angle the user chooses. The result brings the precise, confident movement of a premium compact to a mono-material paper structure designed for circularity.
